arabicExcerpts.text: وَأَمَّا عَادٞ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحٖ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٖ
سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالٖ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومٗاۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةٖ
وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ
فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةٗ رَّابِيَةً
إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ
لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةٗ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٞ وَٰعِيَةٞ

mainSubject.label: The Inevitable Reality announced and its unknowability emphasised by repeated questioning; Thamud and Aad denying the Striking Calamity, Thamud destroyed by an overpowering blast and Aad by a screaming violent wind imposed seven nights and eight days until their people lay like hollow palm trunks with no remains left; Pharaoh, his predecessors and the overturned cities arriving with sin and disobeying their Lord's messenger, seized with exceeding severity; the flood recalled as the occasion when ancestors were carried in the sailing ship, made a reminder for a conscious ear

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the flood-reminder and conscious-ear statement (12) before the Horn blast opens (13); P2 ends with the wound-discharge food verdict (37) before the seen-unseen oath begins (38); P3 runs through the Messenger-word affirmation, the poet-soothsayer denials and the fabrication counterfactual (38-47); P4 covers the reminder-for-the-righteous, the regret declaration, the truth-of-certainty and the closing exaltation (48-52).
